macros.name: dashlinedash
macros.doc: You have two style parameters to control the shape of dash-lines: \dashlinedash is for the length of each dash segment in a dash line; \dashlinegap controls the amount of each gap between dash segments.

macros.name: dashlinegap
macros.doc: You have two style parameters to control the shape of dash-lines: \dashlinedash is for the length of each dash segment in a dash line; \dashlinegap controls the amount of each gap between dash segments.

macros.name: hdashline
macros.doc: Use \hdashline and \cdashline as the counterparts of \hline and \cline.

macros.name: nodashgapcolor
macros.doc: The commmand \nodashgapcolor (no arguments) nullifies the effect of \dashgapcolor.

envs.name: Array
envs.doc: If you feel it tiresome to type the long command/environment name for the activation, you may use Array and Tabular(*) environment in which dash-line functions are always active.
